svg.title: Container Diagram
svg.desc: Runtime modules within the Praetor binary, daemon services, and configuration inputs.

layer"},{"from":"agents_md","to":"compiler"},{"from":"subagents","to":"compiler"},{"from":"cli","to":"gating"},{"from":"cli","to":"compiler"},{"from":"gating","to":"hiss"},{"from":"compiler","to":"vendor"},{"from":"canary","to":"distill","label":"wraps g.text: Reads .agents/ personas and skills (agents.go persona projection).
Then .standards.yaml runners: overrides fleet and org (LoadCascadingRunnerConfigContext, last write wins).
Canary test wraps failure in SARIF.
Distills summary and writes full report.
